title: Venus Reflects Most Sunlight—So Why Is It Hotter Than Mercury?
description:
Venus reflects much of the sunlight that reaches it—so why is it hotter than Mercury?

Venus has an average surface temperature of about 464°C, compared with Mercury's mean surface temperature of about 167°C. The answer lies in Venus's incredibly dense atmosphere, which traps outgoing heat through an extreme greenhouse effect.

Discover the science behind one of our solar system's strangest planetary contrasts.
